HQ IDS (@HQ_IDS_India)

As part of efforts towards infusion of Artificial Intelligence in training, a first of its kind customised GPT named #DRONA (DSSC Resource Optimising Neural Al) ver 1.0 was indigenously developed by Defence Service Staff College Wellington and was launched on #DSSC WAN on 16 Jun 2025.

Towards keeping pace with advancements in the domain of Generative Al and to incorporate indigenous technological stacks, a multi modal DRONA 2.0 GPT was developed integrating the indigenous SARVAM 105b LLM along with open source LLMs. #DRONA 2.0 was launched today by Lt Gen Manish Erry, Commandant #DSSC in the presence of Dr Vivek Raghavan, Co-Founder, Sarvam Al. Along with the launch, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed between #DSSC and SARVAM Al for collaboration and further development of DRONA GPT & various Al based applications.

#DRONA 2.0 is hosted on state of the art GPU server for use in DSSC & has multimodal features like reasoning, document inferencing, image recognition/ generation, text to speech/ speech to text, translation/ transliteration, podcast/ ppt generation and tools for data analytics. Being the first of its kind multi modal GPT in armed forces, the application was subjected to extensive audit and was certified by #HQIDS/ Defence Cyber Agency (DCyA).

DRONA 2.0 is pre-trained on a large repository of the academic content residing at DSSC providing major fillip to faculty, students of DSSC, aiding them towards access of information and progress advanced studies/research in the field of Defence and Strategic Studies.

I think report on future destroyers is mixed up.

What we know so far on the Indian Navy’s destroyer roadmap:

P15A : Kolkata class
P15B : Visakhapatnam class
P15C : 4-ship incremental follow-on, incorporating newer systems
P18A : 8/6 (different reporting) much larger ~14,000–15,000-tonne next-generation destroyers

P15C appears to bridge the gap while P18A remains some years away, with current reporting suggesting its RFP could still be ~3 years away and construction potentially beginning ~8 years from now.

In short: P15C keeps the line moving while P18A takes shape (in theory our first cruiser made at home)
